title: ccops
description: ccops - Clustering of Connectomes Using Probabilistic Tractography

tract_reord.description: Propagate seed reordering onto tract space
tract_reord.title: Tract Reordering

connexity_constraint.description: Add connexity constraint - value between 0 and 1 (0 is no constraint). Default is 0
connexity_constraint.title: Connexity Constraint

matrix_power.description: Power to raise the correlation matrix to (default 1)
matrix_power.title: Matrix Power

brain_mask.description: Brain mask used to output the clustered ROI mask (not necessary if --dir set)
brain_mask.title: Brain Mask

scheme.description: Reordering algorithm. Can be either spectral (default), kmeans or fuzzy
scheme.title: Reordering Algorithm

nclusters.description: Number of clusters to be used in kmeans or fuzzy
nclusters.title: Number of Clusters
